source_runtime: Standalone JavaScript domain logic. The original executable is an offline oracle; fixtures are never runtime inputs. Description search uses a separately decoded typed text-data stream, not native instructions.

native_profile.input: Uppercase injected keys, no idle timeout, immediate MORE

compared: Every draw: actor, width, mixOffset, seed/cursor, exact source addresses and bytes, result and successor
All 24 actor program points, saved arguments and deadlines
All 110 entities: parent, rooms, attributes and status
Every arena byte, including released records; free head and six list payloads
Exact 129 editor bytes and 127 token bytes, including E0 payloads
Exact upper bitmap SHA256 and all 1280 lower bitmap bytes
Original error messages and retained source validity
normalization: None for random, state, buffer or bitmap comparisons

controlled_rules.scope: Controlled native DEC1/DED9 calls from fixed seeded startup data, with bulk/capacity/flag variations. The two mask-error cases additionally execute full commands with all actors. These setups are separate from natural-play sequence parity.

save_load.compared: Every response and complete logical dump, including the next one-minute failure yield and all subsequent NPC choices

source_findings: D2ED sums direct-child bulk with signed overflow saturation; remaining space must be strictly positive
C79A ignores attribute-mask failures during preflight and enforces them during execution
B29A only counts a first argument when exactly one second argument survives
TAKE FROM/OUT OF does not require the named source to be the actual parent
B6FD/B77F description search creates and releases two-byte call records and has a packed-literal-space quirk
CC8C/CEB8 yields after ten failed domain rules, including empty-node/token checks; a rejected node can remain allocated during that yield
E0 tokens retain two value bytes even when ignored by the grammar
IN aliases to VISIT in the supplied distribution; IN and INTO are not silently repaired
limits: Disguises, alternate player identities, clue-specific local rules, locks and deeper examinations remain incomplete
ALL/EXCEPT and all parser/containment combinations are not certified
Old saves missing the new failure budget require a normal paid action to establish known state; no prior count is invented
Original containment-cycle paths are safely rejected by the prototype
No claim of whole-game, graphical-source or unrestricted seed equivalence

listing.scope: Known code/data boundaries; byte identity is not itself a functional proof
